description: Drape of Unyielding Strength Level 60 Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Martial Drape - Onyx Idol x 2 - Bone Scarab x 5 - Silver Scarab x 5 - Cenarion Circle:
